purpose: A review report and its evidence ownership contract. It does not define product-specific acceptance criteria.

steps: Actual reproduction steps; required for observed/finding
checks.execution_id: Required for runtime observed/finding; returned by evaluation_execution.py

scope_limits: Coverage limits; may be an empty array

rules: input sources belong to preserved user input; package sources belong to the frozen workflow package
observed/finding requires actual steps and nonempty local evidence
runtime observed/finding requires captured execution evidence tied to the first artifact
additional evidence paths must not exist before execution; every run preserves its own new outputs
standalone file arguments are tracked relative to runtime/; declare indirect dependencies using --test-input with review-relative paths
implementation, review and capture share POSIX process-group cleanup before snapshots and evidence hashing; detached sessions and non-POSIX execution are unsupported
inspection supports static claims only; it does not establish runtime behavior
scope is used for unverified/not_applicable explanations, not observations
a timed-out execution can support a finding about that execution, not a completed outcome
runtime source files stay unchanged, including additions; configure generated results and mutable state outside runtime/
application file bytes and executable permissions are compared; dependency and interpreter exclusions remain explicit limitations
execution records live in the writable review workspace and are tool-owned by workflow convention, not OS identity; this is not a tamper-proof attestation
structure and revision checks do not prove evidence truth, full coverage, usability, or product acceptance
